object: labeled complete bipartite graph K_{m,n} with fixed labeled bipartition

theorem.square_free_layer: For m+n>=3 all 2-uniform representants are square-free, by the published representation-number theorem.
theorem.structural_form: Every 2-uniform representant is, up to cyclic rotation, A B reverse(A) reverse(B), where A and B are permutations of the two fixed parts.
